summary.text: Pat Harkins, listed as Patrick Harkins by Ballotpedia, is a Democratic state representative from Pennsylvania House District 1 who has served since December 2006 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He works as a driver for United Parcel Service.

paragraphs.text: Patrick Harkins received his diploma from Tech Memorial High School in 1982, and attended Mercyhurst College in 1983 and Pennsylvania State University, The Behrend College, from 1984 to 1987.
His professional experience includes working as a driver for the United Parcel Service.
Harkins served as an elections judge from 1982 to 1987 and as a committeeman from 1991 to 2006.
Harkins assumed office in the Pennsylvania House of Representatives on December 1, 2006.
In the 2023-2024 session, he chaired the Gaming Oversight Committee and served on the Rules Committee.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026, with 99.4% of the vote.
